stories.title: A Scavengers Reign artist explores contemplative sci-fi in new comics
stories.summary: You may recognize Jonathan Djob Nkondo's work from animated projects like the surreal sci-fi series Scavengers Reign or the recent Gorillaz short film The Mountain, The Moon Cave and The Sad God. But before that the French artist and animator made self-published comics that depicted strange alien worlds and future societies. Now he's revisiting that […]

stories.title: Japan Approves the World’s First Treatment Made With Reprogrammed Human Cells
stories.summary: Researchers in Japan pioneered reprogrammed cells 20 years ago. Now the country has given the first-ever authorizations to manufacture and sell medical products based on the technology.
